subject: dbc_contracts
summary: contracts/Reservation.ocl#lookup meets W2 ApplicationPlan dbc apply at standard density: ResultIsHoldDetails now binds result.availableStock to self.availableStock(hold.sku) (current stock, not a reserve-time Hold snapshot), retains AvailableStockUnchanged / HoldsUnchanged, and keeps live HoldMissingOrNotVisibleErrorOnLookup / UnauthorizedErrorOnLookup plus no-mutation failure posts beside PrincipalAuthorized and HoldExists. Not vacuous; named failure channels remain checkable. solidsdd-lint pass with zero findings. Remaining items are polish only.

findings.detail: ResultIsHoldDetails now asserts sku/quantity/expiresAt and current availableStock against @pre hold / self.availableStock, but still does not assert holdId/id equality required by OpenAPI LookupResponse. Independent of W2 availableStock checkability; success-path API symmetry polish only.

On hold-missing, only HoldsUnchangedOnHoldMissingLookup constrains non-mutation; AvailableStockUnchanged remains implied (no sku when hold absent). Enough for R2/SC2 at standard density with retained PreconditionError channel; an explicit stock-side post would be stronger polish, not a missing-pre hole.
